descr: En la entrada de la Universidad una alumna me ha preguntado que para que llevamos las gafas, que se lo ha visto a más compañeros. Creia que era para opticalia, que estuvieron aquí la semana pasada.
descr_english: A student asked me why we were wearing the glasses at the entrance to the university, as she had seen more of her classmates wearing them. She thought it was for Opticalia, who had been here last week.
